Candidates from all over the world can participate in the fully funded scholarship for Master , Specialization, and PhD . The opportunity is offered by ICETEX. The program is open by the Colombia Government to all in any of their relevant fields. The scholarship duration varies according to the program. For specialization, it is 18 months, for masters 2 years and for PhD 4 years. Also apply for ANU International Research Scholarships 2026 in Australia (Fully Funded) . ICETEX stands for the Colombian Institute of Educational Credit and Technical Studies Abroad (Instituto Colombiano de Crédito Educativo y Estudios Técnicos en el Exterior). It is a Colombian government entity responsible for providing financial assistance, scholarships, and educational loans to Colombian students and professionals who wish to pursue higher education or technical studies, both within Colombia and abroad. ICETEX administers various scholarship programs funded by the Colombian government, international organizations, and foreign governments. These scholarships cover different fields of study, and academic levels, and target specific groups such as undergraduate students, graduate students, and researchers. Financial Benefits: Following are the benefits of the Colombia Government Scholarship 2026-27, the selected candidates will enjoy the following Complete Tuition Fee will be covered. Coverage of Medical Insurance Visa. Books and materials costs. Monthly living expenditures and installation costs. Unexpected Costs. Eligibility Criteria for Colombia Scholarship: The candidates would be selected for Colombia Scholarship 2026-27 if they fulfill the following criteria The candidate must be from any country but not from Colombia. Applicant must hold a professional, graduate, or bachelors degree in any area of Field. The candidate must not be more than 50 years old. The candidate must not be married to any Colombian nationality. There is no need for IELTS for admission. Documents Required: Online application Academic curriculum Letter of Recommendation Passport Copy Your CV/ Resume Health Certificate Statement of purpose Application Deadline: The last date to apply for Colombian Government Scholarship 2026-27 is 5th June 2026 . You must have to apply in time to get the opportunity. This opportunity is for those candidates who are interested in Colombia. How to Apply for Colombia Government Scholarship? Candidates who are interested in Colombia Government Scholarship 2026-27 can apply online before deadline. To apply for Colombia Scholarship 2025 you should visit the official website as given below. There, you can see the sights of the program and give in to your application online. You must apply now without waiting for the deadline.
